skill.name: ui-skills
skill.description: Opinionated, evolving constraints to guide agents when building interfaces
skill.summary: Opinionated, evolving constraints to guide agents when building interfaces
skill.author: sickn33

security_audit.summary: The two static network findings are GitHub URLs used for source attribution and documentation links in SKILL.md. No evidence found of executable network calls, prompt injection text, data exfiltration intent, scripts, or command execution.

finding_verdicts.reason: Line 4 is frontmatter source metadata pointing to a GitHub repository. It is not an instruction to fetch data or send information over the network.
Line 22 is a documentation link to the source repository. It does not perform a network request or expose user data.

content.value_statement: AI-built interfaces can drift into inconsistent patterns and unclear design choices. This skill gives agents focused constraints for interface work.
actual_capabilities: Guides AI agents toward opinionated interface-building constraints.
Supports Claude, Codex, and Claude Code assisted UI work.
Frames when to apply the skill during interface projects.
Provides high-level guidance and patterns for building interfaces.
Links to the upstream repository for additional context.
limitations: It contains guidance only, not executable UI code.
It does not include automated design validation or tests.
It depends on the user to provide project context.
It references an external repository for more information.

use_cases.title: Improve New UI Screens
use_cases.description: Use the skill to guide an agent while creating interface layouts with consistent constraints.

use_cases.title: Review Agent UI Output
use_cases.description: Apply the guidance when checking whether generated screens follow clear interface patterns.

use_cases.title: Standardize Interface Prompts
use_cases.description: Use the skill as a shared instruction layer for teams asking agents to build interfaces.

prompt_templates.title: Create A Simple Interface
prompt_templates.prompt: Use ui-skills while designing a simple interface for [product area]. Keep the layout focused, clear, and consistent.

prompt_templates.title: Improve An Existing Screen
prompt_templates.prompt: Use ui-skills to review this screen: [screen description]. Suggest changes that improve structure, hierarchy, and usability.

prompt_templates.title: Guide A Feature Workflow
prompt_templates.prompt: Use ui-skills to design the workflow for [feature]. Cover the main states, controls, and user decisions.

prompt_templates.title: Audit A Generated Interface
prompt_templates.prompt: Use ui-skills to audit this AI-generated interface: [description]. Identify weak patterns and propose focused corrections.

output_examples.input: Design a settings screen for a project management app.
output_examples.output: A focused settings layout with grouped controls, clear labels, restrained spacing, and predictable navigation.

output_examples.input: Review a generated dashboard for usability issues.
output: The dashboard should reduce competing visual emphasis.
Primary actions should be closer to the related data.
Empty and loading states should follow the same visual system.

best_practices: Provide the agent with the product domain and target user.
Ask for concrete interface states, not only a static layout.
Review generated output against your existing design system.
anti_patterns: Using the skill without describing the interface goal.
Expecting it to replace a full design system.
Applying the guidance after implementation instead of during planning.

faq.question: What does this skill help with?
faq.answer: It helps agents apply interface-building guidance and constraints during UI design tasks.

faq.question: Does it generate complete UI code?
faq.answer: No. It provides guidance that can shape how an agent creates or reviews interface work.

faq.question: Which tools can use it?
faq.answer: The report lists support for Claude, Codex, and Claude Code.

faq.question: Is there executable code in the skill?
faq.answer: No. The reviewed file is a prompt-only skill with no scripts.

faq.question: Can it enforce my design system?
faq.answer: It can guide the agent, but you must provide your design system rules.

faq.question: Why are GitHub links mentioned in the audit?
faq.answer: Static analysis flagged source links as network indicators, but they are documentation references.
